- 📋 Interactive quote viewing with service line items
- 🔄 Real-time frequency updates with optimistic UI
- 💰 Automatic savings calculations (Member vs Standard pricing)
- 🔔 Toast notifications for user feedback
- ⚡ Loading states and error handling
- 🧪 Comprehensive test coverage

- Node.js 18.x or 20.x
- npm or yarn

```bash
npm install

Create a `.env.local` file with:

AIRTABLE_API_KEY=your_api_key

npm run dev

- `npm run build` - Build for production

  push:
    branches: [ main, develop, 'feat/**', 'fix/**' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x]
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        cache: 'npm'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
    
    - name: Run TypeScript type checking
      run: npm run typecheck
    
    - name: Run ESLint
      run: npm run lint
    
    - name: Run tests with coverage
      run: npm run test:coverage
      env:
        # Set test environment variables
        AIRTABLE_API_KEY: 'test-api-key'
        AIRTABLE_BASE_ID: 'test-base-id'
        AIRTABLE_TABLE_QUOTES: 'Quote Requests'
        AIRTABLE_TABLE_LINE_ITEMS: 'Quote Line Items'
        AIRTABLE_FIELD_TOKEN: 'Token'
        AIRTABLE_FIELD_QUOTE_ID_LOOKUP: 'Quote ID (from Request)'
        NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE: 'http://localhost:3000'
    
    - name: Upload coverage reports
      if: matrix.node-version == '20.x'
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: coverage-report
        path: coverage/
    
    - name: Build application
      run: npm run build
      env:
        # Set build environment variables
        AIRTABLE_API_KEY: 'test-api-key'
        AIRTABLE_BASE_ID: 'test-base-id'

  code-quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20.x'
        cache: 'npm'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
    
    - name: Check for dependency vulnerabilities
      run: npm audit --audit-level=high
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Check code formatting
      run: |
        npx prettier --check "**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,json,css,md}" \
          --ignore-path .gitignore \
          --ignore-path .prettierignore 2>/dev/null || true
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Check for outdated dependencies
      run: npm outdated || true
      continue-on-error: true
